intro: An Altered Snapjaw Shell is the carapace of a freshwater turtle inhabiting the lush oases of the Barrens. Druids studying the region examine these mutated shells to understand how strange subterranean fissures are warping the local wildlife.

p: The freshwater turtles dwelling within the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases have undergone noticeable, unnatural changes. Believed to be drinking from springs fed by mysterious underground fissures, the oasis snapjaws exhibit altered carapaces that intrigue researchers at the Crossroads. Tonga Runetotem, a tauren druid seeking to divine the health of the land, gathers these shells to determine whether the energies welling up from the deep earth are an unnatural blight or something far stranger.
